title: Warrington's 'most haunted house' returns with terrifying new features
excerpt: WARRINGTON’S ‘most haunted house’ is back, with interactive fun, spooky visuals, and terrifying thrills.
content:
WARRINGTON’S ‘most haunted house’ is back, with interactive fun, spooky visuals, and terrifying thrills.

Andy Czyzewski, who works as a captain flying commercial airliners, has built what he describes as Warrington’s ‘most haunted house display’, featuring elaborate animatronics and custom effects.

Writing in a post on Facebook, Andy said: “Step into a world of creeping fog, green swamp lasers, eerie sounds, and full-size monsters – if you dare!

Andy has put a lot of effort into his haunted house (Image: Andy Czyzewski)

“My Halloween display is finally ready after months of hard work.”

This year, the house features an interactive ‘push-to-activate’ section, visuals including window projection movies and a singing pumpkin projection, and a vomiting skeleton.

The display also includes a smoke-filled bubble machine and motion-activated full-size monsters.

There's plenty to explore - if you dare (Image: Andy Czyzewski)

Andy’s Halloween showcase is for a good cause.

He runs a free, voluntary search and rescue group using a thermal drone to help reunite families with lost pets, and all donations will go directly towards maintaining the equipment and licensing fees.

The house is open daily from dark until 10 pm, and can be found at: Deans Wharf, Deans Lane, Thelwall, Warrington, WA4 2GT.
